    - Start PostgreSQL: `docker compose -f tests/compose-postgres.yml up -V --force-recreate --wait --remove-orphans`
    - Stop PostgreSQL: `docker compose -f tests/compose-postgres.yml down -v`
- Test commands:
  - Run all tests (with PostgreSQL setup/teardown):
    ```
    make start-postgres && LANGGRAPH_TEST_FAST=0 uv run pytest $(TEST); \
    EXIT_CODE=$$?; \
    make stop-postgres; \
    exit $$EXIT_CODE
    ```
  - Run fast tests (in-memory checkpointer only, no DB):
    ```
    LANGGRAPH_TEST_FAST=1 uv run pytest $(TEST)
    ```
  - Run tests in watch mode (with PostgreSQL setup/teardown):
    ```
    make start-postgres && LANGGRAPH_TEST_FAST=0 uv run ptw $(TEST); \
    EXIT_CODE=$$?; \
    make stop-postgres; \
    exit $$EXIT_CODE
    ```
  - Run specific test file by setting environment variable TEST, for example:
    ```
    make test TEST=tests/test_some_file.py
    ```
